core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Yik Yak anonymity with street-wear brand aesthetics.
Content is King: The text posts are the hero. Typography must be bold.
Contrast: High contrast borders and vibrant accents.

rules: Use 2px solid borders for cards to create a 'sticker' look.
Primary color is for 'University' mode, Secondary (Lime) is for 'City' mode.
Upvote = Orange/Red, Downvote = Blue/Purple (Classic Yak colors).

buttons.classes: rounded-full border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all active:translate-y-[4px] active:shadow-none font-bold uppercase tracking-wide

cards.classes: bg-card border-2 border-border rounded-xl p-6 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] transition-all

inputs.classes: h-12 rounded-lg border-2 border-border bg-background px-4 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 font-medium

navigation.classes: fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border border-border/20 rounded-full p-2 shadow-2xl flex gap-2 z-50

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for UI icons. Use 'phosphor-icons' (Duotone) for feature highlights.

motion.loading: Use a custom 'bouncing ball' loader instead of a spinner.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. SETUP: Install 'lucide-react' and 'framer-motion'. Add the Google Fonts to index.html.
2. THEME: Implement the 'Electric Campus' color palette in tailwind.config.js. Ensure Dark Mode works via a toggle.
3. LAYOUT: Build the 'Feed' as the central experience. It should feel like an infinite scroll of 'stickers'.
4. TOGGLE: Create a prominent 'City / Uni' toggle at the top of the feed. This is the core navigation mechanic.
5. POSTS: Post cards must be highly legible. Use 18px+ for post text. Hide metadata (time, distance) until necessary or make it subtle.
6. AUTH: The Landing Page should be high-energy. Use the 'hero_students' image with a 'cutout' effect or bold typography overlay.
7. FAB: The 'Create Post' button must be a Floating Action Button (FAB) on mobile, bottom-right or center-bottom.
8. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (upvote-btn, downvote-btn, comment-btn, toggle-feed).
9. DO NOT use generic gradients. Use solid colors or noise textures.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop' - no generic centered layouts.
